budget.explanation: Charged ceiling includes the previous unmatched 16-row ATTEMPT. It is not an exact unique or durable vector count.

coverage: Finite positive residual time and reconciliation; exhausted/NaN/inf budgets rejected.
A completed real encoding receipt must have zero distance pairs, all required arrays, cumulative encoded charge and unchanged 4 CPU/8 GiB/20 GiB limits.
Synthetic, partial, wrong-charge and hidden prior AB/model runs rejected.
Independent verification receives only residual time with zero pairs/encoded allowance.
Verification errors or final cumulative wall overflow do not publish FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.
deployment_obligation: The deployment must enforce the additional 18000-second monotonic deadline from new remote encoding start through retrieval, evaluation and independent verification. Stage receipt summation by itself omits transfer and setup overhead.
